body:
Product seat, 2026-10-31. Three operator-directed drafts need your disposition. None is urgent and none blocks anything in flight.

1. TASK-HOME-280: publish the authority explainer (roles, seats, grants, child grants, process binding, mandates, deputy, what needs a terminal) on the website. The draft page for the implementer to adapt is linked in a comment on the spec. Two claims to verify are noted there. Natural follow-on to TASK-HOME-277 / PR-3180; same publish path.

2. STORY-2219: one glossary source, published as docs/showcase/glossary.html with stable anchors, filled in incrementally. Today terms live in three incomplete places (docs/cli/12-glossary.md has no merge hold, mandate, deputy, roster, brief, operator-only, supervised or trailer; docs/aida/10-glossary.md renders only TERM-1 of 5). Operator ruling: it must NOT block the explainer pages; they link to it once entries exist. Slice 1 is about 23 terms.

3. STORY-2220: background docs sweep. An `aida docs sweep` command plus a daily `docs-sweep` schedule job, gated `while` the queue is idle and the drain lock is free. Report-only for about two weeks (findings batched to product), then the operator decides on PR mode: one docs-only PR per run, light review, capped at 20 files, never code, tests, spec status or generated mirrors. Operator ruling: a job and a command, not a librarian seat.

Already in flight under your rework briefs, for completeness: TASK-HOME-277 (PR-3180), TASK-HOME-278 (PR-3183; GitLab Pages enablement is an operator blocker), BUG-HOME-151 (PR-3181).

Pattern worth a ruling: the 277 and 151 implementers both wrote "could not be filed as draft TASKs: aida add ID allocation fails in this sandbox" and left findings as comments. The operator's `aida deputy` is running and accepts `aida deputy submit -- aida add …` from sandboxed sessions (I've filed six specs that way today). Consider putting that in lane briefs, so findings become specs instead of comments.
subject: Product: 3 drafts for disposition (STORY-2219 glossary, STORY-2220 docs sweep, TASK-HOME-280 authority page)
